Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an incorrect criterion—treating “are both orchids?” as “are both accepted genera in POWO”—and concluded “No.” Laeliocattleya, while a nothogenus (intergeneric hybrid) between Laelia and Cattleya, is still within Orchidaceae; hybrids are orchids. Thus both Broughtonia and Laeliocattleya are orchids, so the correct answer is “yes.”
